mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_applications ( id, enterprise_id, job_id, candidate_id, resume_id, idempotency_key, status, created_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{resumeId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, false ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ja.job_id, ja.candidate_id, r.id AS resume_id, r.file_name AS resume_file_name, ja.ai_match_score, ja.status, ja.created_at, ja.updated_at FROM job_applications ja join resumes r ON ja.resume_id = r.id WHERE ja.is_deleted = false AND ja.id = #{applicationId} AND ja.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}

SELECT ja.id, ja.job_id, ja.enterprise_id, j.title AS job_title, ja.ai_match_score, ja.status, ja.created_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id WHERE ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND ja.is_deleted = false
AND ja.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ja.created_at
ASC DESC
